build_system: Vite with Tailwind CSS, no brazil or complex build
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify no compilation errors. Visually inspect functionality in browser.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node.js available. No test framework.
contribution_requirements: Single-file React app pattern in src/App.jsx. All state/logic in one component.
key_patterns: All canvas objects (nodes, groups, images) use absolute positioning with x/y coordinates. Groups use computeLayout() for auto-sizing. updateActiveWorkspace() is the primary state updater. takeSnapshot() for undo history. getDescendants() for group hierarchy traversal. Images are stored as ws.images array with {id, x, y, width, height, src}. drawCurve() draws bezier paths for edges. Groups have theme field from THEMES object.
directory_structure: src/App.jsx - main app (4732 lines), src/MiniMap.jsx - mini map component, src/index.css - Tailwind base styles, src/main.jsx - React entry point
